title: Contract
description: `.hexagen/contract.json`: what the slice may and may not depend on. The built-in rule id `unresolved-import` covers an unresolved in-slice specifier. `knownViolations` entries have the shape of the ratchet baseline (tools/arch-linter/src/ratchet-baseline.ts). Mirrors packages/shared/src/types/brownfield/contract.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Consumers understand the 1.x line only.

from.description: Repo-relative, case-sensitive. A trailing / makes a directory prefix; anything else is an exact file path. `.` and `..` segments, empty segments, absolute paths, backslashes and NUL are refused.
